guard.note: per slot: event.getEntity().getItemBySlot(slot).getAttributeModifiers(slot) (the wrapped call), its STEALTH entries summed; modifyVisibility(max(1 - sum, 0)); then the looker type / head checks
getAttributeModifiers: the stack's NBT modifiers or its item's, then ForgeHooks.getAttributeModifiers (an answer of the stack, the slot and the event's listeners only)
posts ItemAttributeModifierEvent (stack, slot, modifiers) and answers the event's modifiers

opposing_force_stealth_tick_memo.conversion: Trade-off, off by default: on ForgeEvents.onLivingVisibility, @Inject HEAD names the event's entity's memo for this tick in a per-thread box (StealthMemo.begin), MixinExtras @WrapOperation on its ItemStack.getAttributeModifiers (m_41638_) call answers from the memo, @Inject RETURN clears the box; a field added to LivingEntity (LivingEntityStealthMemoMixin, duck StealthMemo.Holder) keeps per slot the answer and the stack object for the current game tick of the entity's level; a later visibility test of the same entity in the same tick gets the kept map while the slot holds the same stack object. A stack changed in place or a listener answer changed within the tick is seen from the next tick. Memo owned by the thread that made it. Runtime flag opposingForceStealthTickMemo, shadow opposingForceStealthTickMemo.shadow. Helper bons.furious.patch.opposing_force_coo49.StealthMemo.
